name: qfd_ucie_gearbox_r10
conservative_timing_envelope: All five roots are signed off as related same-PLL phase-0 roots at the common 833.333 ps leaf period. True periods: core 833.333, fdi/fdi_rx 1000, blk_tx/blk_rx 5000 (one PLL, aligned 5 ns frame). The r10 RTL has no core<->FDI path; every true cross-root setup relation is >= 833.333 ps (results/rtl/qwen_coll_io_1014/block_stage_sta_r10_1015/r10/record.json, ordinary STA from one 200 MHz reference, no exceptions) and every true hold relation is >= the modelled coincident-edge 0, so the common-period sign-off is strictly tighter than the true relation for every path. Die STA applies the true generated clocks.
why_floorplan: W face = core side (597+1 in, 597+1 out, fault); E face = UCIe FDI side (1043+1 TX, 1043+1 RX, fault; 2,089 pins over 216 um: the route places M4 pins at 2 tracks each in groups of 32, 172.8 um gave 1,785 slots (gate d861c9dd7 pin_fit FAIL)) to abut the PHY W-face pin block; S = five roots + reset. Outline from gate 1e991bc08: std area 7,662 um2 -> util ~0.52-0.54 with the +586 FF beat-3/pad registers. WIDTH 86.4 -> 129.6 (gate 59a5169a5 --cts FAIL DPL-0033): the r10 crossings are flop-to-flop at coincident edges of separate CTS roots, so FF hold repair after CTS inserts ~5,650 um2 of hold buffers (16,746 endpoints, ws -95.6 -> +10 ps; movable area 9,798 -> 15,448 um2 = 89.4% of the 86.4x216 core) and detailed placement cannot legalize. 129.6x216 (27,994 um2) gives ~55% after hold repair (the 1e991bc08 gate at this outline passed CTS); pre-CTS util ~0.28 is the expected util-band WARN, the room is the measured hold-buffer area, not slack.
slot_change_request: NEW leaf inside the compute-die IO collective band next to ot_qfd_ucie_x64_phy W face (pin block y 600..700.4). Outline provisional, sized by this gate; compute lead / geometry must grant the slot before routing.
structural_change: r10 replaces the r9 direct 1.2 GHz core <-> 1 GHz FDI gearbox (ordinary STA relation 166.7 ps, slack -48..-633 ps pre-placement) with a 200 MHz block stage: 4x3588 payload FF (r9: 5x3588), constant 19 core edges (r9: 24), same 1043-bit 4-of-5 FDI beat calendar. Gate 1e991bc08 WARNs fixed structurally: every boundary input registered before check logic (beat 3 captured full width, padding OR on registered bits; PHY valid pin flop), registered one-hot stage/beat enables replace binary decodes (2,088-load decode nets), outline 86.4x216 (util ~0.43; height fixed by the 2,089-pin FDI face). Gate d207fd319 FAIL DPL-0038 at util 0.55 after timing repair buffered 600-load select nets: stage/read selects now three copies (199 bits each) and FDI beat enables five copies (<=209 bits each), all <=256 loads, copies cross-checked by the fault logic.

job.purpose: Harden the r11 UCIe gearbox leaf (r10 block stage + half-cycle fast-root negedge registers on every wide cross-root crossing; r10 a534fb815 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD -104 ps / 16,901 endpoints); TT/FF at 833.333 ps.
